name: Roland RD-700NX
description: Roland RD-700NX SuperNATURAL stage piano: the system blocks and the whole temporary Live Set (common and EQ, song/rhythm, chorus, reverb, eight MFX, resonance, and each of four layers' internal and external zone, tone, piano, electric piano and tone-wheel organ settings), from the MIDI Implementation.

sources.title: RD-700NX MIDI Implementation (version 1.00, Oct. 10, 2010)
sources.notes: Parameter Address Map read by tools/profiles/roland/parse-address-map.mjs from RD-700NX_MI2.pdf (sha256 79566b1f86e72e4b6a212b9c2230457a0232b7efd63980691d63ebc23f5b01c6). Model ID 00 00 50, DT1 = 12, RQ1 = 11, Roland checksum. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/roland/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/roland/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is the manual's, at the manual's address, with the manual's name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

Layers 1-4 are the offset table's "(Layer: 01)" to "(Layer: 04)": Internal Layer 10 00 30 00-10 00 33 00, External Layer 10 00 40 00-10 00 43 00, Tone 10 01 00 00-10 01 03 00, Piano 10 02 00 00/20 00/40 00/60 00, E.Piano 10 06 00 00-10 06 03 00, ToneWheel 10 07 00 00-10 07 03 00 (p9). Live Set Common names four zones UPPER1, UPPER2, LOWER1 and LOWER2 (Slider Assign, MFX Control Destination, p10); the address map does not say which layer is which zone, so the groups keep its numbers.
Model ID: every byte list (p5, p8), the address map (p9) and both worked examples (p13) give 00 00 50; the prose on p5 says "00H 00H 2BH", the RD-700GX's.
Dates: the MIDI Implementation is headed Oct. 10, 2010, version 1.00 (p1); its Implementation Chart (p15) is dated Nov. 10, 2010.

System Favorite Live Set (p9) prints one row pair, "Favorite1 - 40 Live Set Category" (00 06) and "Favorite1 - 40 Live Set Number" (00 07, three nibbles), then ":" to a last Number at 01 23. At four bytes a favorite this closes on 40 favorites and the Total Size 00 00 01 26, but the map has one row per name and the run is not written out, so only Favorite 1 is laid out (as favorite1LiveSetCategory/Number); favorites 2-40 are at 00 0A + 4 x (n - 2) (category) and the three bytes after it (number).

System Switch Assign prints "One Touch Piano Variation Number" at 00 00-00 02 and "One Touch E.Piano Variation Number" at 00 03-00 05 with no number (the Favorite block's matching rows say Piano1-3, E.Piano1-3); they are numbered 1-3 in printed order.

Live Set Common prints "EQ Mid Frequency", "EQ Mid Gain" and "EQ Mid Q" twice (00 34-00 36 and 00 37-00 39): two mid bands, numbered 1 and 2 in printed order. Its EQ frequency lists print "200.250" for "200, 250" (p10), so they count 30 labels for 31 values and stay numbers 0-30 with the manual's list as their description.

Internal Layer prints "Receive Modulation Switch" and "Receive Bender Switch" twice (00 0F/00 10, among the controller switches with Damper, FC1, FC2, the sliders and S1/S2; and 00 1A/00 19, among the received-message switches with Bank Select, Program Change, Volume, Pan, Hold-1 and Expression). They are numbered 1 and 2 in printed order.
Eight MFX blocks are printed (MFX: 01-08, 10 00 10 00-10 00 1E 00, two apart), though the controller assignments name only MFX1 and MFX2 (FC/S1/S2/Slider Assign); all eight are laid out as printed.

Live Set Piano MicroTune 1-128 (00 0B-04 07, four nibbles each) are 128 per-note tuning values (one per note number, it appears; the manual prints only the rows), beside Stretch Tune Type OFF/PRST/USER.

Display ranges one step off their wire ranges, kept as printed: Live Set Tone's Cutoff, Resonance, Attack, Decay and Release Time (00 0A-00 0E, p12) are 0-127 over "-63 - +63" (the External Layer's matching values print "-64 - +63"); Slider Assign (UPPER2), (LOWER1) and (LOWER2) (Live Set Common 00 47-00 4B, p10) are (0 - 133) over "0 - 134".

Labels printed once for a run: Harmonic Bar Assign (LOWER2:ON) (00 4F) carries the footage list and the seven rows after it carry none, so only the first is a menu; the rest are numbers 1-9. MFX Control Destination prints its last label "LOWRE2" (sic). Sound Focus Type is (0 - 31) over seven labels and stays a number with the list as its description.

Not read at startup (read on request, since the instrument may not answer them): layer1.piano, layer1.ePiano, layer1.toneWheel, layer2.piano, layer2.ePiano, layer2.toneWheel, layer3.piano, layer3.ePiano, layer3.toneWheel, layer4.piano, layer4.ePiano, layer4.toneWheel.

coverage.inboundControllers: not modelled: what the sliders, pedals, S1/S2 and the harmonic-bar assignment transmit as Control Change (Data Transmission, p6-7) is not mapped yet
coverage.effectParameterMeanings: type-dependent: chorus, reverb and MFX parameters are Roland's 4-nibble container (12768-52768, shown -20000..+20000); what each slot does depends on the selected type, which the MIDI Implementation does not list
coverage.presets: none: neither manual prints a Bank Select table for Live Sets; Program Change is received as "prog.1 - prog.128" and Bank Select as "bank.1 - bank.16384" with no list of what they select, so no preset banks are listed
coverage.notModelled: nothing in the address map is left out: System (00 00 00 00) and the Temporary Live Set (10 00 00 00) are laid out whole. Of the System Favorite Live Set block only Favorite 1's two rows are addressable (see notes)
